venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology

records.fact: The direct TOSEM journal author-guideline page was not publicly retrievable in the final check.
records.title: TOSEM author guidelines
records.evidence: The direct page returned HTTP 403 in the final public check. Current portal-specific anonymity, upload-slot, supplement, declaration, and length fields cannot be asserted from it.

records.fact: The supplied class is acmart version 2.19 dated 2026-06-27; the project releases one generic ACM single-column pre-submission rendering.
records.title: acmart — Class for typesetting publications of ACM
records.locator: acmart.cls ProvidesClass declaration and deterministic build script
records.evidence: The sole manuscript and supplement use manuscript,screen,review. The bundled class remains byte-identical to the supplied template. No alternate publication-layout PDF is released.

records.fact: The current official generic ACM journal manuscript template specifies the manuscript class option for the review version and says accepted manuscripts are transformed during production.
records.title: Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) — Generic Journal Manuscript Template
records.evidence: The retained source uses manuscript,screen,review, yielding a single-column review PDF. The direct TOSEM portal remains authoritative for any venue-specific override.

records.fact: The current official acmart sample declares each author separately, permits repeated or shared affiliation declarations, asks for full names and email addresses, uses shortauthors for running heads, and requires journal author addresses.
records.title: Official acmart samples
records.locator: acmsmall submission sample, author and affiliation instructions
records.evidence: The final source uses four separate author declarations and four separate affiliation declarations so that each author renders on a separate line; Huaijin Ran has the NTU affiliation and corresponding-author mark.

records.fact: The native acmart 2.19 corresponding-author command is used for Huaijin Ran, and each supplied ORCID is attached to its respective author block.
records.title: ACM consolidated LaTeX styles
records.locator: acmart.cls correspondingauthor definition and rendered title page
records.evidence: The envelope mark appears beside Huaijin Ran in the sole manuscript and matching supplement. The four supplied ORCID identifiers pass checksum validation; the source does not infer authorship eligibility from those identifiers.

records.fact: A 2026 editor-organized Journal Ahead Workshop for TOSEM and TSE describes its TOSEM/TSE review process as single-anonymous, with author names and affiliations visible.
records.title: Journal Ahead Workshop 2026
records.evidence: Used only as strong provisional orientation because it is not the direct TOSEM submission guide.

records.fact: ACM requires valid ORCIDs for accepted journal authors before publication; the corresponding author is responsible for collecting them.
records.title: ACM journal author instructions: ORCID mandate
records.evidence: All four authors now have supplied ORCID identifiers in the source. Portal authentication and accepted-paper production requirements still require live confirmation and human control.

records.fact: No numeric TOSEM page or word cap is asserted in this internal release.
records.title: TOSEM author guidelines
records.evidence: The manuscript uses LIMIT_KIND=NONE; the conclusion and References heading share page 34 in the sole pre-submission PDF. This is an editorial outcome rather than a claimed venue limit.

records.fact: The official ACM review template uses manuscript mode for a required single-column review rendering; the review option supplies line numbers, and authors must not alter margins, typeface sizes, line spacing, paragraph/list definitions, or vertical spacing.
records.title: ACM review template, line-number, and modification rules
records.locator: Template description and source sections Template Parameters and Modifications
records.evidence: The released PDF is single-column; line numbers 1 through 1924 occur continuously in the review margin; no geometry, margin, line-spacing, typeface, or negative-spacing override occurs in either source.

decision: The four-author source uses the byte-identical supplied acmart 2.19 class in the official generic single-column review mode. Class-generated line numbers are retained and continuous, margins and typography are unmodified, unassigned production metadata is absent, and one deterministic manuscript plus one supplement is released. Direct TOSEM portal fields remain a submission-policy hold because the public guide returned HTTP 403.
